## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
glimpse(penguins)

```
## Average bill length by species

```{r}
bill_summary <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(avg_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))

bill_summary
```


## Plot of average bill length

```{r}
ggplot(bill_summary, aes(x = species, y = avg_bill_length)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Bill Length by Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Average bill length (mm)"
  )
```
